t: 列克星敦号蒸汽船在长岛近海四英里外起火并下沉,损失了139人.
te: The steamship Lexington burns and sinks four miles off the coast of Long Island with the loss of 139 lives.
dz: 列克星敦号蒸汽船在长岛近海四英里外起火并下沉,损失了139人.
de: The steamship Lexington burns and sinks four miles off the coast of Long Island with the loss of 139 lives.

t: 签署"威坦哲条约",将新西兰确立为英国殖民地.
te: Signing of the Treaty of Waitangi, establishing New Zealand as a British colony.
dz: 签署"威坦哲条约",将新西兰确立为英国殖民地.
de: Signing of the Treaty of Waitangi, establishing New Zealand as a British colony.

t: 英国维多利亚女王与萨克森-科堡和哥达的阿尔伯特亲王结婚。
te: Queen Victoria of the United Kingdom marries Prince Albert of Saxe-Coburg and Gotha.
dz: 英国维多利亚女王与萨克森-科堡和哥达的阿尔伯特亲王结婚。
de: Queen Victoria of the United Kingdom marries Prince Albert of Saxe-Coburg and Gotha.

t: 盖塔诺·多尼泽蒂所出演的歌剧"La fille du régiment"在法国巴黎获得了首次演…
te: Gaetano Donizetti's opera La fille du régiment receives its first performance in Paris, France.
dz: 盖塔诺·多尼泽蒂所出演的歌剧"La fille du régiment"在法国巴黎获得了首次演出.
de: Gaetano Donizetti's opera La fille du régiment receives its first performance in Paris, France.

t: Penny Black邮票在大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国生效.
te: The Penny Black postage stamp becomes valid for use in the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland.
dz: Penny Black邮票在大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国生效.
de: The Penny Black postage stamp becomes valid for use in the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland.

t: 大纳特切斯"旋风"袭击了纳特切斯,密西西比州共造成317人死亡. 这是美国历史上第二个致命的龙…
te: The Great Natchez Tornado strikes Natchez, Mississippi killing 317 people. It is the second deadliest tornado in United…
dz: 大纳特切斯"旋风"袭击了纳特切斯,密西西比州共造成317人死亡. 这是美国历史上第二个致命的龙卷风.
de: The Great Natchez Tornado strikes Natchez, Mississippi killing 317 people. It is the second deadliest tornado in United States history.

t: 废除将英国罪犯流放至新南威尔士殖民地的规定。
te: The penal transportation of British convicts to the New South Wales colony is abolished.
dz: 废除将英国罪犯流放至新南威尔士殖民地的规定。
de: The penal transportation of British convicts to the New South Wales colony is abolished.

t: Samuel Morse获得了电报的专利.
te: Samuel Morse receives the patent for the telegraph.
dz: Samuel Morse获得了电报的专利.
de: Samuel Morse receives the patent for the telegraph.

t: 7.4级地震袭击了现在的土耳其和亚美尼亚；再加上亚拉拉山火山喷发的影响，造成 10,000 人…
te: A Ms 7.4 earthquake strikes present-day Turkey and Armenia; combined with the effects of an eruption on Mount Ararat, k…
dz: 7.4级地震袭击了现在的土耳其和亚美尼亚；再加上亚拉拉山火山喷发的影响，造成 10,000 人死亡。
de: A Ms 7.4 earthquake strikes present-day Turkey and Armenia; combined with the effects of an eruption on Mount Ararat, kills 10,000 people.

t: 欧洲列强缔结伦敦公约以稳定近东。
te: The Great Powers of Europe conclude the convention of London in order to stabilise the Near East.
dz: 欧洲列强缔结伦敦公约以稳定近东。
de: The Great Powers of Europe conclude the convention of London in order to stabilise the Near East.

t: 加拿大省是根据联邦法案创建的。
te: The Province of Canada is created by the Act of Union.
dz: 加拿大省是根据联邦法案创建的。
de: The Province of Canada is created by the Act of Union.

t: 在英国舰队的轰炸下,英土部队攻占了贝鲁特.
te: An Anglo-Turkish force captures Beirut with the help of bombardment by an English fleet.
dz: 在英国舰队的轰炸下,英土部队攻占了贝鲁特.
de: An Anglo-Turkish force captures Beirut with the help of bombardment by an English fleet.

t: 威廉二世出任荷兰国王.
te: Willem II becomes King of the Netherlands.
dz: 威廉二世出任荷兰国王.
de: Willem II becomes King of the Netherlands.

t: 马龙派领袖巴希尔·谢哈卜二世向奥斯曼帝国投降，随后被流放至马耳他。
te: The Maronite leader Bashir Shihab II surrenders to the Ottoman Empire and later is sent to Malta in exile.
dz: 马龙派领袖巴希尔·谢哈卜二世向奥斯曼帝国投降，随后被流放至马耳他。
de: The Maronite leader Bashir Shihab II surrenders to the Ottoman Empire and later is sent to Malta in exile.
